rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep over body (lines 1–94) for \bhonest, \bdelve, landscape(verb), importantly, crucial, substrate, leverage(verb), synergize, paradigm shift, em-dash: zero hits

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban in any curriculum/training surface.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No \britual\b or \bceremony\b in body (lines 1–94). Word 'exercise' used correctly throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 46 contains "the old rules" in context of recovery instruction for overwrites. Maintainer block line 109 accepts-by-design as boundary case per check_student_facing.md §5: recovery instruction in body while scrollback is live is exceptional. Not session biography, not a stale marker—functional instruction. No other stale markers found.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 voice quintet (Boris, Martin, Godin, Sutherland, Siilasmaa) deployed appropriately. Big Idea: warm + direct (Sutherland reframe). Prework: factual operational. Start here: direct question (Godin). Key Concepts: factual + strategic. Register consistent; no consultancy pap, no poster tone, no marketing defensiveness.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File is a curriculum module, not an article draft. Rule applies to article roughcuts only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Argyris cited by name (line 62) for double-loop learning; Klaassen, Cherny, Martin, Horthy credited in body/maintainer block. (Sub: creator name) No 'Antti', 'the creator', 'the author' (noun), 'course creator', 'training creator' in body. (Sub: author-we) No author-we ('we designed', 'our training', 'we built'); voice stays second-person or impersonal. All sub-clauses PASS.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body uses second-person 'you' consistently (lines 6, 26, 42, etc.). No 'the student' (noun), no 'the trainer shows', no delivery mechanics. Grep clean.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terms in body (plan-reading, two reads, push-back, walk-down, gates) all have earning moments in exercises/lectures. No unearned maintainer-only terms (substrate, three-pattern, grill-me) leaked. Grep clean.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reassurance-shaped phrases ('no penalty', 'fine way to', "it's OK if", 'you are not on the hook', 'not a box-check') in body. Delegation descriptions carry no paired absolution. Grep clean.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule applies to reference artefacts with 'Frame to land' sections. This file is a module, not a reference. N/A.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Simon Willison named three times in body (lines 77, 79, 85), but all are preread/link entries. Line 77: '**Read:** Simon Willison, [trifecta link]' (preread, link). Line 79: '**Read:** Simon Willison, [agentic loops link]' (preread, link—newly added 2026-08-21). Line 85: '**Read:** Simon Willison, [agentic loops link]' (preread, Module 4, link). Per rule 11 carve-out (Antti 2026-08-15): 'Prereads and links don't count... any name labelling a link = attribution bookkeeping the reader scans, exempt.' All three Willison entries exempt. Body-prose mentions (non-preread, non-link) = zero. PASS on the cap.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea (line 6) is punchy: 'Plausible isn't good enough, and you are the one who can tell the difference.' This is a direct principle statement, not an overreaching claim. No carve-out needed; the statement is bounded by its context (this module's plan-evaluation skill). Rule 12 applies to claims that overstay their scope; this one doesn't. PASS.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No value-prop defensive phrases: no 'not an aspirational', 'not a vendor', 'not theoretical', 'unlike consultancy', 'grounded in actual', 'the real practitioners'. No positioning-vs-vendor framing. Module teaches plan-reading directly; no defensive posture. Grep clean.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Technical terms (plan mode, gate, push-back, walk-down) earned operationally within this module (M2) or upstream (M1). No L3+ terminology planted ahead of earning module. Vocabulary appropriate to arc position. Revision pass also checked: no replacement introduces new jargon.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Section 'Save the rule if it earned itself' (lines 36–54) contains instructions with forcing function. Pronouns ('that one branch', 'it', 'them') all resolve clearly to their referents. No dangling pronouns or demonstratives with >1 possible referent. No vague spatial/temporal metaphors standing in for action. Cold read of closer: action and referents clear.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The **What happened:** block is OPTIONAL — default is to omit it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File is a module, not an exercise. The 'What happened:' block rule applies to exercise files only. N/A.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Agent interaction verbs in body (ask, tell, integrate, restore, confirm, reframe) are peer-flat or warmer. No combative verbs (bark, order, command, whip, force, drag, push around, boss, shout, snap, lecture, scold). Grep clean.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers (Big Idea, Prework, What You'll Learn, Start here, Save the rule if it earned itself, Key Concepts, Optional challenges, Next) all accurately describe their content. No metaphors contradicting mechanism. No 'other X' presupposing unnamed primary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negation (visible, not merely hoped). No deictic drumroll (This is the X + X is...). No bold-label echo. No citation/appendix duplication. Prose is lean and direct.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'Five criteria' (line 18) embedded within first bullet's description, not standalone lead preceding list—differs from violation pattern. 'Two sources' (line 22) similarly embedded. These are memory handles within operational text, not redundant counts preceding lists. Rule test passes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for §12.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No superlatives (only, always, never, nothing else, the one thing) in body prose asserting false scope. Factual claims hold. Line 57 uses '10%' estimate with hedge ('Assume about'); maintainer block line 107 attests this prior is load-bearing from M1. No false slogans.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer block line 121 notes source verification for Willison essay is checked live and assigns it in every cut (six-module arc as second pre-read entry; Module 4 fallback). Claim freshness stamped at source verification point. No sibling corpus instances carrying superseded versions detected in scope.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session — re-derive it per target, not per sweep.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule 23 is about sweep-execution methodology (re-derive rule set per file when rules are still landing). It governs orchestrator behavior, not file content itself. N/A for individual file judge.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: One doc per scarce-attention audience; delta-only.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule applies to multi-doc structures for time-pressured audiences (trainers, execs). This file is a single module in a curriculum. N/A.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trainer-facing text is self-contained.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule scope is trainer-facing text below `<!-- maintainer -->` cut (line 95+). Writing-class judge evaluates body only (lines 1–94). N/A for body evaluation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A sentence saying how you'd know points at the outcome, not the nearest artifact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No self-witnessing clauses (read judging its own context, summary reporting on itself). Instructions point at observable outcomes: 'ask Claude whether these rules auto-load'—observable in session behavior. Rule test passes.
